content: Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, ɑ Isirelibɑ mɔndu kuo.

A nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, ɡunɔ bɑkeru ɡɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ tɑ kɑsɑ dɛ̃u mɑ tɑ sɑn bɑkɑsu mɔ si su nɔni bwese bwesekɑ mɔ. Mɑ tɑ yɔ̃ɔwɑ tɑ dɑ sere Libɑnin ɡuurun wii kpiirɔ. Mɑ tɑ dɑ tɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛdurun wii kpiiru wĩɑ.
Mɑ tɑ dɑ̃ɑ ten kɑ̃ɑsɑ ye yɑ ɡunum bo wĩɑ tɑ kɑ dɑ tɑ yi tem mi bɑ rɑ tenkuru ko, wuu ɡè sɔɔ tenkubɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Mɑ tɑ dɑ̃ɑ kpii pɔturɑ ɡɑɑ suɑ tɑ dɑ tɑ ɡirɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ye yɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ nim bɔkuɔ mi tem ɡem mu wɑ̃ɑ, mi nim mu yibɑ.

Kpii pɔturɑ ye, yɑ seewɑ yɑ kpɛ̃ɑ nɡe resɛm koru te tɑ yɑsiɑ ɑdɑmɑ tɑ ǹ ɡunu. Mɑ ten kɑ̃ɑsi yi mɛɛrɑ ɡunɔ bɑke ten berɑ ɡiɑ. Mɑ ten ɡbini yi duɑ tem mɛn sɔɔwɔ. Mɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye, yɑ ɡɔsiɑ resɛm, yɑ kpɑrɑ yɑ kɑ̃ɑsi kuɑ.
Yen biruwɑ ɡunɔ bɑkeru ɡɑrɑ nɑ tɑ kɑsɑ dɛ̃u. Ten sɑnsu tɑɑsinɛ. Mɑ resɛm koo te, tɑ ten ɡbini kɑ ten kɑ̃ɑsi ɡɔsie ɡunɔ bɑke ten mi ɡiɑ, domi tɑ tɑmɑɑ tɑ koo nim wɑ mi ɡiɑ.
N deemɑ tɑ rɑɑ ɡirewɑ tem ɡem sɔɔ mi nim yibɑ kpɑ tu kɑ̃ɑsi ɡeenu ko tu bii ɡeenu mɑ kpɑ tɑ n sɑ̃ɑ resɛm ɡeɑ.

Wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ bikiɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, resɛm yen bweseru yɑ koo kpĩ yu kuurɑ? Gunɔ bɑke ɡbiikii te, tɑ koo wurɑ tu ye deri tɑ kun yen ɡbini wukurɑ? Tɑ koo wurɑ tɑ kun yen mɑrum ɡo, kpɑ ten kpɑrɑ kpɛm mɛ, mu ɡberɑ? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, n ǹ mɑɑ tilɑsi tɔn dɑbinu bu nɑ bu kɑ ye wukɑ.
Wee tɑ duurɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɑ koo kuurɑ? Sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun woo ɡɑ̀ n tu bɑbɑ, tɑ ǹ koo ɡberɑ? Geemɑ tɑ koo ɡberɑ mi tɑ duurɑ.
Mɔn ten tubusiɑnu
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
ɑ Yudɑn mɛm nɔɔ sɑri be bikio ɑ nɛɛ, bɑ mɔn ten tubusiɑnu yɛ̃? A bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, wee Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. U ben sinɑ boko mwɑ kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu mɑ u kɑ bu dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Mɑ u turo ɡɔsɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ nɡe kpii pɔturɑ sinɑ bibu sɔɔ, u kɑ nùn ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ. U nùn bɔ̃rusiɑ. Mɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wi, u ben bukurobu ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ win temɔ.
Kpɑ Yudɑbɑn tem mu biru wurɑ, mu ku mɑɑ kuurɑ. Kpɑ bu win ɑrukɑwɑni ye mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Adɑmɑ be Yudɑbɑ bɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wi seesi bɑ sɔmɔbu ɡɔrɑ Eɡibitiɔ bu kɑ dumi kɑsumɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ tɔn dɑbinu. Wi u yen bweseru kuɑ, u koo kisirɑ? Domi u ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, sere kɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑru, sinɑ boko wi, u koo ɡbiwɑ sunɔ wi u nùn bɑndu wɛ̃n temɔ. Domi u ǹ win nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibie. Bɑbiloni miyɑ u koo ɡbi.
Bɑɑ Eɡibitin sunɔ ù n tɑbu kowo dɑbiru mɔ be bɑ dɑm mɔ, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u bu somi bu kɑ tii yinɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u koo nɑ u wɔrusu ɡbe u tɑbu sĩɑ kpĩ u kɑ tɔn dɑbinu ɡo.
Domi durɔ wi, u mɑɑ win nɔɔ mwɛɛru ɑtɑfiiru kuɑ, mɑ u ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑ yè sɔɔ u rɑɑ win nɔɔ mwɛɛru doke. Yen sɔ̃, u ǹ kisirɑmɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, sere kɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑru, nɛn ɑrukɑwɑniwɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u ɑtɑfiiru kuɑ u kusiɑ. Yen sɔ̃, u koo yen ɑre wɑ.
Kon nùn yinɑ bɛriɑ kpɑ u wɔri ye sɔɔ. Kon kɑ nùn dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ. Miyɑ kon nùn siri win nɑɑnɛ sɑri te u kuɑn sɔ̃.
Win tɑbu kowo be bɑ koo duki su, kon bu nɑɑ swĩiwɑ n ɡo kɑ tɑkobi. Be bɑ tiɑrɑ kpɑ bu yɑrinɑ nɡe woo. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔn nɔɔ mwɛɛru
Amɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, nɛn tiiwɑ kon dɑ̃ɑ kɑ̃ɑsɑ kpɛmɑ mɛɛri sɛduru yen wii kpiirɔ kpɑ n ye burɑ, kpɑ n dɑ n ye ɡirɑ ɡuuru ɡɑrun wɔllɔ te tɑ ɡunu.

Kon ye ɡirɑwɑ ɡuuru ɡɑrun wɔllɔ te tɑ ɡunum bo Isireliɔ. Ten kɑ̃ɑsi yi koo kuurɑwɑ kpɑ tu binu mɑ tɑ n sɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑ te tɑ wɑɑbu wɑ̃. Gunɔ bwese bwesekɑ yɑ koo sokuru ko ten kɑ̃ɑsi sɔɔ. Kpɑ su n kukuɑ ten sɑɑrɔ.

Sɑɑ yerɑ dɑ̃nu kpuro nu koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ. Nɛnɑ nɑ rɑ dɑ̃ɑ ni nu ɡunu kɑwe, kpɑ n ni nu piiburu bo ɡunum sosi. Mɛyɑ nɑ rɑ ni nu wuru bekusu sɑ̃ɑ ɡberɑsie, kpɑ n ni nu ɡbere bɔrɔm dokeɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ. Mɛyɑ yɑ koo mɑɑ koorɑ.
Gusunɔ u rɑ bɑɑwure siriwɑ
nɡe mɛ win dɑɑ yɑ nɛ
